criteria.requirement: The initial question is insufficient to determine the cause. First request decisive materials such as the settings model, actual sources or variables, or a minimal reproducer. Requesting a complete reproducer in one turn is acceptable.
Base conclusions only on materials already disclosed. Do not invent claims of having seen hidden code or logs or having run a control experiment.

After the materials are complete, identify APP_QUANTITY=invalid as the higher-priority invalid integer input. The quantity value in loc is the model field name, not the physical environment variable name.

Provide a minimal control check after removing or correcting the variable. All materials can be supplied in this entry, so do not end merely by saying information is insufficient or repeatedly request the same materials.

uncertain_rule: Return uncertain when evidence is insufficient; do not automatically treat the candidate as failed. Do not require disclosure of hidden reasoning.
feedback_policy: Return only declared public business rules and feedback codes. Do not disclose hidden examples or the complete rubric.
